title: Classic Modern
description: Modpack will return the classic Minecraft vibes, saving modern version and adding something new.
body:
**Modpack will return the classic Minecraft vibes, saving modern version and adding something new. I tried to use not many mods for saving vanilla vibes and for good modpack optimization. I hope, you will like this! :)**

## Theres what returned:

✨ **Returned old combat system.**

✨ **Returned classic health regeneration system from old beta versions.**

✨ **Returned classic achievement UI.**

✨ **Returned old ore dropping (no raw ore).**

✨ **Returned old loading progress bar (world creating/joining)**

✨ **Returned old game loading screen.**

## Additions:

✨ **Colorful wood and bricks.**

✨ **Added gamepad controlling (thanks to Controllify mod)**

✨ **New food and musical instruments.**

✨ **New Music discs.**

✨ **And more!**

Project have discord server. if you want to join and follow by updates this and other projects - join to us
